messages:
rafael_sales: Quick heads-up 12 MercuryHealth procurement asked for a HIPAA-ready evidence bundle for the Dedicated POC. They want SOC2 in-scope control mapping, ISO27001 cert copy, a signed pen-test letter (explicit scope: staging + on-prem possibility), encryption at rest details, and confirmation we can sign a BAA. Deadline: next Tue COB. Can we mobilize?
lena_security: We can provide SOC2 mapping and the ISO cert copy. BAA yes. For the pen-test: we can supply a vendor attestation or our internal summary + vendor letter when available. Need to confirm whether they require result details or just attestation.
joey_eng: For on-prem feasibility note 12 we support a private deployment package but HIPAA on-prem has extra engineering checklist (HSM integration, local logging collector, no external telemetry). Estimated prep time for a reproducible on-prem bundle: ~2 weeks.
rafael_sales: They're also asking if adding HIPAA/on-prem triggers a pricing uplift for the POC. Procurement wants an official line so they can OK spend.
maya_cust_success: Pricing: standard Dedicated POC includes SOC2 artifacts and an attestation. On-prem deployment & long-term managed BAAs are quoted separately. For the POC we can offer a one-time setup fee waiver if they commit to a 6mo reserved capacity. I can draft language.
legal_bot: Checklist created: [SOC2_control_mapping.xlsx, ISO27001_cert_scanned.pdf, pen_test_attestation_template.docx, BAA_template.docx, encryption_at_rest_summary.md]
lena_security: Encryption blurb draft: "All customer data at rest is encrypted with AES-256. Keys are customer-managed in supported KMS providers or Redwood-managed HSM-backed keys. Disk snapshots exclude PII unless explicitly enabled; access to backups is audited and restricted to control-plane ops."
joey_eng: I'll produce a sanitized staging network diagram and a note on logging/retention. We should redact private IPs and internal hostnames but show segmentation and egress controls.
rafael_sales: Procurement also requested a single-sentence commitment that POC data won't be used for model training. Can we provide that?
legal_bot: Suggested line: "Redwood will not use customer POC or production data to train or improve models without explicit written consent; data processed for the POC will be retained only per the retention terms in the executed agreement."
maya_cust_success: Timeline recap: SOC2 mapping + ISO cert + encryption blurb by Fri EOD, pen-test attestation by Mon (internal attestation) and vendor-signed letter TBD (3-7 business days). On-prem feasibility note and quote by next Tue morning. Rafael, I'll write the procurement note including the conditional pricing uplift language.
rafael_sales: Great. Can we also include who signs the pen-test attestation? Legal prefers vendor + Redwood exec sign-off. Lena, can you loop in our vendor contact?
lena_security: Looping vendor now via email (not in Slack). I'll upload drafts to the secure drive and flag files with REDACTED for IPs. Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/secure_poc_mercuryhealth (redacted link).
rafael_sales: Thanks team 12 once we have the bundle Ill package and send to MercuryHealth procurement. :rocket:
